reason: Right now every rupee is going towards the wedding and school fees, and I cannot take on another ₹2,000 a month for a year just so the wash finishes when the light goes. We have managed with hand washing until now, and that can wait.
objection: Will a cold wash really get the mud out of farm clothes, or will I end up scrubbing them by hand anyway? Then I am paying nearly ₹22,000 for a machine when an ordinary semi-automatic costs much less.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour or the dealer showed me it cleaning our muddy clothes on battery during a power cut, and the EMI came down to around ₹1,200 a month after the wedding is done.
